translations.web: A nation which you don’t know will eat the fruit of your ground and all of your work. You will only be oppressed and crushed always,
translations.bsb: A people you do not know will eat the produce of your land and of all your toil. All your days you will be oppressed and crushed.
translations.kjv: The fruit of thy land, and all thy labours, shall a nation which thou knowest not eat up; and thou shalt be only oppressed and crushed alway:
